caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate object positioned diagonally from the lower left to the upper right against a plain, off-white background. The object appears to be made of dark material, primarily colored in deep browns with subtle hints of reddish undertones and some lighter areas that define its three-dimensional structure. The form is intricate, featuring a flowing, curvilinear design with loops, swirls, and a central spherical element incorporated among the curves. There are two main elongated, tubular arms that branch away from each other, with one arm being slightly thicker and having a rounded, looped end, while the other arm is more tapered. An additional protruding peg or lever-like extension is evident near the center. The object's shadows and highlights are carefully illustrated, giving it a realistic and dimensional appearance. The lower right corner of the drawing includes a small, purple signature reading "CHRIS MARENOS."
title: Bootjack
